note: A named bundle of mechanical behaviour on top of the personality every contact has (patrons.md section 6). contacts.md section 1 reserves 'personality' for the weight vector, and the two words must not merge. Every knob here is an id into a code-side table: one that is turned when he arrives, or one that is read where it is needed. A knob nothing turns and nothing reads is refused by the validator.

entries.note: A refusal cuts deeper than it would. A per-contact weight on REFUSED, which is the same deed everyone else feels.
He will not take no. He writes again and again, and tone.md's eagerness carries him into desperation on its own.
He reads the colony as richer than it is, so his asks grow without a rule that says they should. The greed is derived from the perception.
He talks. Granting banks more prestige and refusing costs more of it, both through the one term.
His regard follows the colony's net contribution to the Crown, and deliberately not prestige - which would close a loop, since his regard is itself part of prestige.

He watches how the colony is governed and cannot be seen doing business with a man who is losing his. The month after any town declares, his regard falls and he writes that he can no longer be associated with the colony; his policies end with that letter (issue 444, patrons.md section 6). Every declaration does it again.

He draws one resource he disapproves of at arrival, which his need and specialty never name; each month the colony sells it to the Crown his regard falls, and now and then he writes to say so (issue 444, patrons.md section 6).

Everything he gives lands late: his one-offs arrive and his policies take effect this many months after the PC accepts them, where another patron's land the month after. Nothing warns the PC (issue 444, patrons.md section 6).
He offers his specialty only once. Declined or ignored, it is never offered again for his stay, where an ordinary patron may offer again (issue 444, patrons.md sections 4 and 6).

He knows people. The one new mechanic here - his displeasure travels to the Crown's officers, and per contacts.md section 6 they write to say so. One-directional and shallow: the officers reach nobody.
